description: List the Discussion comments on an initiative — the same threaded comments the console renders on the initiative. Oldest first; resolved comments are included (each carries its `resolved` flag and `anchor`). Read-only. ONE PAGE per call (50 by default, 100 max): the result carries `meta` with `hasMore`, `nextCursor` and `appliedFilters`. When `meta.hasMore` is true, pass `meta.nextCursor` back as `cursor` to get the next page.
name: anyforge_list_initiative_comments
title: List initiative comments
